scope: Fixed owned-fresh pre-product-init legacy source data; no runtime SQL/drop-guard API, no fake authenticated actor, no real payment/AI
sourceSchema: Actual current Python Store sqlite_master CREATE TABLE after real migrations; no business triggers copied in legacy seed phase. Product init installs all current guards afterwards.

schema:
CREATE TABLE digital_entitlement_grants(
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,order_id TEXT NOT NULL,item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 content_id TEXT NOT NULL,media_id TEXT NOT NULL,policy_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
 uses_per_unit INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(uses_per_unit>0),original_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(original_quantity>0),
 used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(used>=0),overused INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(overused>=0),
 starts INTEGER NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE digital_order_snapshots(
 item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,order_id TEXT NOT NULL,content_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 media_id TEXT NOT NULL,policy_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE membership_ai_allocations(
 job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,period_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 reserved_credits INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reserved_credits>=0),
 charged_credits INTEGER CHECK(charged_credits IS NULL OR (charged_credits>=0 AND charged_credits<=reserved_credits)),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','settled')),created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE membership_ai_events(
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,period_id TEXT NOT NULL,job_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 action TEXT NOT NULL,credits INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE membership_ai_periods(
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,subscription_id TEXT NOT NULL,item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 cycle_start INTEGER NOT NULL,cycle_end INTEGER NOT NULL,credits INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(credits>=0),
 balance INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(balance>=0),reserved INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reserved>=0 AND reserved<=balance),
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','frozen','closing','closed')),reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 policy_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,benefits_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(owner,item_id,cycle_start)
)

schema: CREATE TABLE commerce_entitlements(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_orders(id),item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES commerce_order_items(id),content_id TEXT NOT NULL,type TEXT NOT NULL,quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,remaining INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','revoked')),created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE commerce_orders(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),request_id TEXT NOT NULL,fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,fulfillment_status TEXT NOT NULL,aftersale_status TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,subtotal_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,shipping_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,tax_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,total_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,refunded_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,shipping_address TEXT NOT NULL,tracking TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',reserved_until INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(owner,environment,request_id))

CREATE TABLE commerce_payment_events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_orders(id),request_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('sandbox_pay','refund')),fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,items TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status='applied'),created INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(owner,environment,kind,request_id))

CREATE TABLE commerce_products(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('digital','physical','membership')),environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment IN ('sandbox','production')),status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft','published','archived')),version INTEGER NOT NULL,content_id TEXT NOT NULL,shipping_countries TEXT NOT NULL,shipping_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(shipping_minor>=0),tax_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(tax_minor>=0),mutation_id TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

CREATE TABLE commerce_skus(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_products(id),sku TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL,price_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(price_minor>=0),currency TEXT NOT NULL,stock INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(stock>=0),reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reserved>=0 AND reserved<=stock),version INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(environment,sku))

CREATE TABLE digital_entitlement_grants(

CREATE TABLE membership_ai_allocations(

)

 action TEXT NOT NULL,credits INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL
)

 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,subscription_id TEXT NOT NULL,item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 cycle_start INTEGER NOT NULL,cycle_end INTEGER NOT NULL,credits INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(credits>=0),

CREATE TABLE commerce_order_items(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_orders(id),sku_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_skus(id),product_id TEXT NOT NULL,title TEXT NOT NULL,type TEXT NOT NULL,quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0),price_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,unit_shipping_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,unit_tax_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,content_id TEXT NOT NULL,price_version INTEGER NOT NULL,refunded_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(refunded_quantity>=0 AND refunded_quantity<=quantity),snapshot_data TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',UNIQUE(order_id,sku_id))

CREATE TABLE commerce_orders(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),request_id TEXT NOT NULL,fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,fulfillment_status TEXT NOT NULL,aftersale_status TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,subtotal_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,shipping_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,tax_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,total_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,refunded_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,shipping_address TEXT NOT NULL,tracking TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',reserved_until INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(owner,environment,request_id))

CREATE TABLE commerce_payment_events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_orders(id),request_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('sandbox_pay','refund')),fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,items TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status='applied'),created INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(owner,environment,kind,request_id))

CREATE TABLE commerce_products(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('digital','physical','membership')),environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment IN ('sandbox','production')),status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft','published','archived')),version INTEGER NOT NULL,content_id TEXT NOT NULL,shipping_countries TEXT NOT NULL,shipping_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(shipping_minor>=0),tax_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(tax_minor>=0),mutation_id TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

CREATE TABLE commerce_skus(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_products(id),sku TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL,price_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(price_minor>=0),currency TEXT NOT NULL,stock INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(stock>=0),reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reserved>=0 AND reserved<=stock),version INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(environment,sku))

CREATE TABLE digital_entitlement_grants(
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,order_id TEXT NOT NULL,item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 content_id TEXT NOT NULL,media_id TEXT NOT NULL,policy_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
 uses_per_unit INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(uses_per_unit>0),original_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(original_quantity>0),
 used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(used>=0),overused INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(overused>=0),
 starts INTEGER NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE digital_order_snapshots(
 item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,order_id TEXT NOT NULL,content_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 media_id TEXT NOT NULL,policy_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE membership_ai_allocations(
 job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,period_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 reserved_credits INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reserved_credits>=0),
 charged_credits INTEGER CHECK(charged_credits IS NULL OR (charged_credits>=0 AND charged_credits<=reserved_credits)),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','settled')),created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE membership_ai_events(
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,period_id TEXT NOT NULL,job_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 action TEXT NOT NULL,credits INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE membership_ai_periods(
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,subscription_id TEXT NOT NULL,item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 cycle_start INTEGER NOT NULL,cycle_end INTEGER NOT NULL,credits INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(credits>=0),
 balance INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(balance>=0),reserved INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reserved>=0 AND reserved<=balance),
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','frozen','closing','closed')),reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 policy_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,benefits_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(owner,item_id,cycle_start)
)

CREATE TABLE membership_order_snapshots(item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),order_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_version INTEGER NOT NULL,group_id TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,subscription_id TEXT,payment_event_id TEXT,period_start INTEGER,period_end INTEGER,state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',created INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE membership_subscriptions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),group_id TEXT NOT NULL,original_item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,current_item_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_version INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('trialing','active','renewal_failed','grace','paused','past_due','cancelled_active','expired','revoked')),auto_renew INTEGER NOT NULL,period_start INTEGER NOT NULL,period_end INTEGER NOT NULL,grace_end INTEGER,trial_end INTEGER,next_charge_at INTEGER,cancelled_at INTEGER,version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL)
